newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's Santer to see Jospin over EMU budget pact.
newsitem.headline: EU's Santer to see Jospin over EMU budget pact.

text.p: European Commission President Jacques Santer will meet French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on Thursday to discuss France's problems with the European Union's stability pact, a Commission spokesman said.
A European Union source said Santer would present a proposal for meeting France's concerns. He said the Commission was "putting the finishing touches to the text".
EU's Santer to see Jospin over EMU budget pact

French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn told a meeting of EU finance ministers on Monday that France's new government -- pledged to turning Europe's focus to growth and jobs -- was not ready to accept immediately the pact limiting budget deficits after the launch of the EU's single currency in 1999.

But he told a news conference "The French government is utterly determined to launch EMU on time", stressing that it did not want to renegotiate the pact, but wanted time to consider it, and look at ways of reinforcing political co-ordination inside the euro zone to seek policies to encourage growth and lower unemployment.
He said he thought it would be hard to reach an accord in time for a summit of EU leaders in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17.

His statement threw France's EU partners into turmoil -- not because of the substance of the French demands -- but because of the risk that political momentum towards a single currency could be slowed by failure to approve the accord in Amsterdam as planned.
